subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, may expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and what should OpenClaw do when a referenced value is missing or blocked?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but it controls credential propagation across workspace, global/state-dir, legacy gateway, and generated service environments.

options.title: Expand trusted sources only
options.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, while keeping workspace credential/control protections intact.

options.title: Keep dotenv literal
options.body: Document `.env` values as literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRefs, shell env, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Expand all dotenv sources
options.body: Allow both project and global `.env` expansion, accepting a larger workspace-trust and upgrade/security test burden.

recommendation.title: Expand trusted sources only
recommendation.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, while keeping workspace credential/control protections intact.
